en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like a maintenance room for a
robot. There are machine parts everywhere.
This...is definitely Keebo's lab.
Whose...lab is this?
...Huh? Isn't it yours?

I don't want this. I don't like this sort of...
sci-fi technology.
...Can we leave now?

But I imagine that a lot of things in here would
really help you out. You should take a look.

No...I do not want to be assisted by 
sci-fi technology.

We shouldn't rely on the power of sci-fi
for anything.
<CLT=cltMIND>Wouldn't that include you, Keebo?

Anyway...I would prefer a more Japanese
theme, since I like that food the most.
...Even though I can only stare at it.
<CLT=cltMIND>So how could you prefer the food?

At the very least, I'd like some kimonos in my
lab and a porch with wind chimes.
Y-Yeah...that would be nice.

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't seem like Keebo is
going to use this lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, he's free to do as he pleases.
Nothing I can do about that.

I don't want this to be my lab. I don't like
sci-fi technology.

I'd rather have Japanese clothing such as
kimonos, and a porch with wind chimes, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't seem like Keebo is
going to use this lab.
<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing I can do about that.

Hah-haha! This is fuckin' awesome! Look at
all these upgrade parts!
Ohhh, you'd look so pretty with this, Keebo...

I want you to make lots of cute noises!
Heh, hehehehe...

S-Stop! Don't mention that in front of
Shuichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>Is that...something to be
embarrassed about, Keebo?
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>These monitors are everywhere,
but I don't see any cameras.

<CLT=cltMIND>How is the mastermind behind this
killing game monitoring us?

<CLT=cltMIND>Or...are we not really
being watched at all?

Alright, I've finished investigating all
the items this time.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito should be waiting in the dining
hall. I should gather everyone there.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spoke with everyone and told them
to gather at the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>After a time, everyone had
gathered in the dining hall.
